exposure: placement of a fan-shaped hand inside the uterine cavity during caesarean delivery following the delivery of the foetus
cohort: 1216 mothers scheduled for caesarean sections at Bankura Sammilani Medical College in Bankura, West Bengal, India, with 610 in the study group and 606 in the control group. The mean maternal age was 23.08+/-3.67 years in the study group and 23.12+/-4.02 years in the control group.
finding: Placement of a fan-shaped hand inside the uterine cavity during caesarean delivery following fetal delivery improved confirmation of uterine contraction, reducing atonic PPH, maternal morbidity and mortality, and the need for additional uterotonic agents, operating time, and operative interference.
